t: Abaoji united the Khitan tribes and proclaimed himself emperor in 916; the state took the dynastic name Liao in 947.
It ruled nomads and Chinese farmers through a dual system of Northern and Southern Administrations.
The Treaty of Chanyuan of 1005 brought Song silver and silk; the Jurchen Jin destroyed the Liao by 1125.
dyk: Cathay, the medieval European name for China, and Kitai, its Russian name, both come from the Khitan, the people who ruled the Liao empire.
ev: Abaoji proclaims himself emperor of the Khitan
The Khitan destroy Balhae and set up the client kingdom of Dongdan
Later Jin hands over the Sixteen Prefectures around modern Beijing
Yelü Deguang takes Kaifeng and adopts the dynastic name Liao
The Treaty of Chanyuan brings annual Song payments of silver and silk
The wooden Sakyamuni Pagoda at Yingxian is completed
Wanyan Aguda proclaims the Jin dynasty and routs the Liao at Hubudagang
The Jin capture the last Liao emperor, Tianzuo

f.capital: Shangjing; five capitals in all (also Dongjing, Nanjing, Zhongjing and Xijing), with a mobile court
